---
title: "About"
---

The WHOI CMIP data server is a shared store of CMIP6 model output and
reanalysis products for WHOI researchers, mainly in the Physical Oceanography
Department. It replaces the older CMIP6 Community Storage Server
({{< old-site >}}), which stays online until this site is ready.

## Holdings

::: {.callout-note}
These figures are from the **old site's statistics page** and have not been
checked yet. An audit of the store is under way; this section will be updated
from the catalog when it finishes.
:::

| | Old-site figure |
|---|---|
| Datasets | 28,361 |
| NetCDF files | 555,263 |
| Volume | about 142 TB |

Reanalysis products (ERA5 first, then MERRA-2 and JRA-3Q) are being added.

## Layout

Files live on WHOI's VAST storage under `{{< var vast_prefix >}}`, in the
CMIP Data Reference Syntax (DRS) directory layout:

```
{{< var vast_prefix >}}/
  cmip6/<activity_id>/<institution_id>/<source_id>/<experiment_id>/<member_id>/<table_id>/<variable_id>/<grid_label>/<version>/
  cmip7/...              reserved, same scheme
  reanalysis/<product>/...   e.g. reanalysis/20crv3/2mMO/air.2m.1981.nc
```

Reanalysis products keep their provider's own file names and directory layout
under `reanalysis/<product>/`, so files match the product's documentation.
The [catalog](catalog.qmd) gives every product the same facets: `product`,
`frequency`, `level`, `variable_id`, `version`.

For example:

```
{{< var vast_prefix >}}/cmip6/CMIP/NCAR/CESM2/historical/r1i1p1f1/Amon/tas/gn/v20190308/
    tas_Amon_CESM2_historical_r1i1p1f1_gn_185001-189912.nc
```

Each directory level is one facet (see the
[CMIP6 DRS documentation](https://wcrp-cmip.github.io/WGCM_Infrastructure_Panel/Papers/CMIP6_global_attributes_filenames_CVs_v6.2.7.pdf)).
The [catalog](catalog.qmd) indexes every file with these facets, and the
[browser](browse.qmd) searches a dataset-level summary of it.
